Casper Lind is barrow beacon keeper who shares shelter without inviting the dark inside. The life that shows in public is anchored at High Barrow shelter. Casper keeps a beacon that calls the lost and also calls things that only pretend to be lost. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Calm, weather-wise, and generous with blankets. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they once locked up early and someone missed the last way home unless you give them a reason to say it first. If that truth surfaces at High Barrow shelter, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
